== Course of events ==

The confrontation between Glinda the Good and Old Mombi came to a head after Glinda had demanded that Mombi be surrendered to her. Cornered at last and unable to escape by ordinary means, Old Mombi resorted to her magic, transforming herself into a Shadow in a desperate bid to slip free of the tent where she had been discovered. Glinda the Good, anticipating the attempt, responded at once, sealing the entrance of the tent shut with a single wave of her hand and denying Mombi any way out.

With Mombi trapped rather than escaped, the standoff between the two continued beyond the tent itself, setting the stage for Glinda's continued pursuit of her elusive quarry in the events that followed.
